fact: The National Institute of Information and Communication Technologies (INTIC) published the first version of the proposed National Artificial Intelligence Strategy and invited comments from public and private institutions, academia, development partners and citizens, by email, from 4 May to 4 June 2026.

INTIC published the draft Regulation on Cloud Computing Service Providers (version of 23 December 2024) for public consultation, opened 24 February 2025 and running to 30 March 2025, together with a companion data-centre regulation draft; the opening day is inferred from the consultation window.

fact: INTIC, Mozambique's national ICT institute, opened a one-month public consultation on the first version of the draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, running until 4 June 2026, seeking contributions from public and private institutions, academia, development partners and citizens, and held provincial consultation sessions with public sector, private sector, civil society and academia representatives.
INTIC says public consultation sessions and workshops on the draft National AI Strategy are under way in the provinces, with public sector, private sector, civil society and academia taking part.
Banco de Moçambique opened a public consultation on a proposed revision of the notice on protecting customer funds received for mobile money; the document does not say who took part.

INTIC's Onelio Zavala said the draft National Digital Transformation Strategy and National AI Strategy have been prepared through participatory processes and public consultations involving government, the private sector, academia, civil society and disability organisations.

INTIC says regional consultations on the draft national digital transformation strategy collected contributions from public and private sectors, academics, civil society, youth, women and persons with disabilities, in Cabo Delgado, Zambezia, Maputo and Sofala, with a validation workshop in Beira on 12 May 2026.
E&M Magazine reports INTIC has put out for public consultation its regulations on data centres and on cloud computing services.
